enum HxResult

Enumerator:
HX_OK  No error occurred
HX_FAILURE  An unknown or general error occurred
HX_INIT  Initialization error occurred
HX_INTERNAL_ERR  Internal bug or inconsistency has been detected.
HX_UNSUPPORTED  Unsupported operation or argument
HX_UNIMPLEMENTED  Currently unimplemented operation or argument
HX_ACCESS_DENIED  Access to the service or resource is denied
HX_INVALID_ARG  Invalid argument
HX_MEMORY_ERROR  Memory allocation error
HX_RESOURCE_LOCKED  Locked resource
HX_BUFFER_EMPTY  Buffer is empty
HX_BUFFER_TOO_BIG  Buffer is too big
HX_BUSY  Service or resource is busy
HX_TIMEOUT  Service timeout
HX_DESTROYED  Underlying object was destroyed
HX_INTERRUPTED  Operation was interrupted
HX_NO_SUCH_METHOD  No such operation exists
HX_MISSING_FILE  Needed file is missing
HX_INVAREA  Invalid region
HX_SHARED_MEMORY  Shared memory allocation error
HX_NOT_FOUND  Could not find the item specified
HX_INCOMPLETE  Resource provided is incomplete (e.g. truncated graphics file)
HX_NULL_POINTER  Null pointer encountered
HX_BUFFER_FULL  Buffer is full
HX_MISSING_RESOURCE  Specified resource does not exist
HX_RESOURCE_EXISTS  Singleton, this resource already exists
HX_RESOURCE_TOO_BIG  Resource is too big for the operation
HX_BUFFER_TOO_SMALL  Buffer was too small
HX_WRONG_TYPE  Wrong data type used
HX_WRONG_LISTENER_TYPE  Wrong message listener type defined
HX_ALREADY_REGISTERED  Resource or ID already registered
HX_NOT_REGISTERED  Resource or ID is not registered
HX_INVALID_BOUNDS  Invalid bounds
HX_MAX_LIMIT_REACHED  Max limit of entries in API reached
HX_READ_ONLY_VALUE  Read-only value
HX_OPEN_FAILED  Failed to open file, device...
HX_UNINITIALIZED  Some required operation not yet performed
HX_DISABLED  Service or function disabled
HX_TOOL_ERROR  Generic tool error
HX_SOUND_ERROR  Problems with the sound system
HX_ITER_EXCEED  An iterator has run off the end of list
HX_DUPLICATE  attempt to install something that's already installed
HX_USER_CANCEL  user cancelled, e.g. a password dialog
HX_PROPERTY_NOT_FOUND  Property with given ID not found
HX_PROPERTY_WRONG_TYPE  Wrong data type for property used
HX_PROPERTY_DOMAIN_NOT_REGISTERED  Domain is not registered
HX_PROPERTY_READ_ONLY_VALUE  Property Read-only value
HX_PROPERTY_INVALID_INDEX  Invalid set index for property domain
HX_PROPERTY_VALUE_OVERFLOWED  Integer value is bigger than 2^32 - 1
HX_NOT_USER  Caller can't be root
HX_PASSWD_WRONG  Provided password is wrong
HX_GLOBAL_KEY_UNAVAIL  Unable to create or decrypt global key; need user to enter passwd?
HX_FILETYPE_UNKNOWN  Unable to determine type of file (e.g. to know what app to launch for it)
HX_PROPERTY_WRITE_ONLY_VALUE  Property Write-only value
HX_EVENT_HANDLED  Return value for event callbacks if the callback has handled the event, and if the event should not be passed on to the default system handler. Callbacks should return DFB_OK only if the event is not handled, and if the event should be passed on to the default system handler.
HX_MAX_ERROR_CODE  Used to force enum to be a signed int
